title: fix(gen): preserve MIDIjourney system text parts
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16361

- Extracts ordered text parts before merging MIDIjourney system messages, preserving supplied instructions instead of stringifying objects.
- Retains the persona, string/absent-content behavior, non-system messages, options, and both tiers' sampling/token behavior.
- Adds direct and actual schema/registry/request/provider-preparation regressions: five fail before the fix; all 15 pass afterward. Eight related transform suites pass all 224 tests; parent independently verified the 15 regressions/controls.
- Verification: scoped strict types, ES2022 production/pipeline bundles, Biome and diff checks pass. Full local Worker runner/typecheck are unavailable because the sparse checkout lacks Enter setup and Cloudflare type libraries; GitHub Gen CI will verify the configured environment. No live provider calls or Pollen used.

gist.headline: Instructions, not object soup
gist.blurb: MIDIjourney’s system instructions stay in order instead of turning into object-shaped mush. The persona keeps its place, too.
gist.summary: The Gen message transform extracts MIDIjourney system messages’ ordered text parts before merging them, preserving supplied instructions and the persona without changing non-system messages or sampling and token behavior.
gist.impact: MIDIjourney requests with multipart system content retain the intended instructions rather than passing stringified objects to the provider.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the Gen message transform as a cozy retro terminal. Polli, wearing a tiny conductor’s hat, guides ordered text tiles into a single readable system-instruction scroll; a small code-plant beside the terminal adds the garden motif. The ordered tiles, rather than music generation, represent the fix.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, ordered text tiles flow into a readable SYSTEM scroll on a retro terminal glowing lime green (#ecf874), with a little code-plant beside it. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, wears a tiny conductor’s hat, and gently guides the tiles into place against a warm cream and pastel gradient background. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; strictly pixel art, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
